headline: Trump orders Iowa explosives detonation held for court
pages: President Donald Trump said Monday he has ordered the US Army not to detonate about five tonnes of toxic explosives at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant until the Eighth Circuit court agrees it can proceed. A court had paused the plan after environmental groups sued. The Justice Department had told the court the Army still intended to go ahead, citing an immediate risk that degraded lead azide could explode on its own. The detonation had been moved to Wednesday for better weather. Trump called it an opportunity for a highly controlled detonation but said he would wait for the court.
The EPA says no level of lead exposure is safe, and critics said the government was skirting the judicial process. Source: BBC News.
